commit.message:
feat(browser): native supervisor command fastlane — sub-second command pickup

Live-host measurement (2026-09-05): command pickup was cycle-bound at
7.8-336 s (one lease per full supervisor cycle of ~20-40 s) while execution
itself is a stable ~2.4 s. The chat/supervisor control plane could not act
without multi-second-to-minute delays.

- NEW src/native-supervisor-command-fastlane.mjs: transport-only command
  pickup loop on the same signed /v1/commands/next lease endpoint
  (750 ms cadence, bounded exponential backoff 1.5s->8s, reset on success,
  stop-on-self-update, no polling while unenrolled).
- native-supervisor-client-base.mjs: unified #pickupAndRunCommand guarded by
  a local command slot shared by the supervisor cycle and the fastlane;
  start()/stop() lifecycle; command_fastlane snapshot telemetry with explicit
  invariant flags (command_pickup_transport_only, scheduler_authority false,
  command_execution_exclusive local_slot_plus_db_lease_transactional).
- main.mjs opts the shell in (commandFastlane: true, 750 ms).
- Opt-in default-off: zero behavior change for existing consumers.
- Version 0.6.6-dev.16.1. Tests: 9 new (cadence pickup, slot deferral,
  backoff, stop, cycle-pickup regression, wiring contracts); full suite
  1056/1056 green; npm run check green.
- docs/browser-command-fastlane-v1.md: measured problem, invariant amendment
  analysis, brain-side NOTIFY companion channel, follow-ups (issue-gate
  freshness vs heartbeat cadence).
